description: Defines the HostResolverSystemTask class and related functions for asynchronous system DNS resolution with retry logic, including parameters for customization and override capabilities.

classes.name: HostResolverSystemTask
classes.description: Manages asynchronous host resolution with retries, override support, and callback handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new HostResolverSystemTask for a specific hostname and parameters.

methods.name: CreateForOwnHostname
methods.description: Creates a task to resolve the machine's own hostname.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the resolution process, invoking the callback upon completion.

methods.name: was_completed
methods.description: Checks if the resolution has been completed.
